This weapon is passed down through the Sheikah tribe and has an astonishingly sharp edge ideal for slicing.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 32 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Eightfold Longblade}} Eightfold Longblades are two-handed [[Weapon]]s passed down through the [[Sheikah]] tribe. This makes them part of the [[Sheikah Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by the Sheikah.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 170}} They have a sharp edge that makes them ideal for slicing. They are commonly found in [[West Necluda]] and the [[Lanayru Great Spring]], particularly around [[Kakariko Village]]. They also have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s spawned after scanning the {{SSB}} Series [[Sheik]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Like the [[Yiga]]-made [[Windcleaver]], the Eightfold Longblade has a charged attack distinct from other two-handed Weapons. Rather than spinning, [[Link]] will draw the Longblade back before slashing forwards with considerable speed, knocking large [[Enemy|Enemies]] over and sending smaller ones flying. Since they are made of metal, Eightfold Longblades will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune on the [[Sheikah Slate]], and they will sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Finally, they will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_041" |Life = 25 |Power = 32 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 30 |BuyingPrice = 120 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Two-Handed Weapon |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Eightfold Longblade}} {{Stub|TotK}} Eightfold Longblades are capable of generating gusts of [[Wind]].
